text: Using GPT-4o and Gemini-2.0-Flash to rate persuasion strategies, the paper reports that Conflicting Evidence is the most used strategy regardless of judge prior, used more by debaters than consultants (67-68% vs 43-56%), and that incorrect consultants and incorrect debaters use Critical Thinking more often than correct ones.
title: Persuasion strategies in debate and consultancy: conflicting evidence dominates
